searchText: How early can the `random` parameter from `getpayload` be determined? Is it known as soon as the parent block is proposed? <vbuterin> Yes <vbuterin> Ah actually, I'm not sure if in the *current* impl it takes the randao from the current or the previous block <vbuterin> If we add PBS it will have to be previous <vbuterin> Because builders don't know the randao for the block they are proposing until the proposer makes their proposal There is a PR and related discussion around `pre_randao` vs `cur_randao` https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2581 ah, you guys are 10 steps ahead of me - thanks for the link
